vision.mapping: R1-6 assigned to the same-side postsynaptic (p,q) column with greatest absolute connection weight; p/q lattice fitted to each camera image.
limitations: Two low-resolution grayscale pinhole cameras, not calibrated compound-eye optics or color vision.
Light and adaptation are encoded as Poisson drive in the existing LIF engine; real photoreceptors use graded signals.
Unmapped photoreceptors stay in the graph but receive no added visual drive. R7/R8 color pathways are not directly stimulated.

channels.label: Body posture / motion · left
channels.encoding: Population-level boundary proxy: support, joint angles and joint/body velocity. These individual ANs do not have validated tuning to this feature mixture.

channels.label: Antennal deflection / airflow · left
channels.encoding: JO wind/gravity population receives a bounded proxy for antenna deflection, tilt and air-relative movement; tuning/gains are assumed.

channels.label: Head contact · left
channels.encoding: Annotated antennal bristles receive nearby head/antenna surface-contact drive; exact receptive fields are not modeled.

channels.label: Footfall / impact · left
channels.encoding: Sensory-ascending boundary proxy for footfall and impact vibration. No claim of individual leg-joint receptor tuning.
